Subject: We need information from you about your child's care

Dear Mr. Sharma,

Why are you receiving this letter?
We are going to finalize your childcare allowance for 2024. To do this properly, we need information from you about your child's care. Therefore, it is important that you fill out the form included with this letter. And send it along with a copy of the annual statement to us. You can only do this by mail. In this letter, you will read what we expect from you.

Follow these steps to send us your information

Step 1: Find the annual statement of childcare for 2024
The childcare provider emails the annual statement or sends it by mail to you. Sometimes you can find the annual statement in the digital portal of the childcare provider.

Step 2: Copy or print the annual statement of childcare
Do you have multiple annual statements? For example, because your child went to more than 1 childcare provider in 2024? Copy or print them all. Write your citizen service number (bsn) on each copy on the right. Do you not have an annual statement? Then send copies of all invoices from 2024.

Step 3: Fill out the form included with this letter
The information we need from you is on the annual statement of the childcare provider.

Step 4: Send the annual statement and the form before July 11, 2025

Send it to:
Dienst Toeslagen
Antwoordnummer 21440
6400 SL Heerlen
No postage is needed.

Subject: We need information from you about your child's care

Dear Mr. Sharma,

Why are you receiving this letter?
We are going to finalize your childcare allowance for 2024. To do this properly, we need information from you about your child's care. Therefore, it is important that you fill out the form included with this letter and send it along with a copy of the annual childcare statement. This can only be done by mail. In this letter, you will read what we expect from you.

Follow these steps to send us your information

Step 1: Find the annual childcare statement for 2024
The childcare provider emails the annual statement or sends it by mail to you. Sometimes you can find the annual statement in the digital portal of the childcare provider.

Step 2: Copy or print the annual childcare statement
Do you have more than one annual statement? For example, because your child attended more than one childcare provider in 2024? Copy or print them all. Write your citizen service number (BSN) on each copy at the top right. Do you have no annual statement? Then send copies of all invoices from 2024.

Step 3: Fill out the form included with this letter
The information we need from you is on the annual childcare statement.

Step 4: Send the annual statement and the form before July 11, 2025

Send it to:
Dienst Toeslagen
Antwoordnummer 21440
6400 SL Heerlen
No postage is needed.
